FAQ

Common questions

Clear answers about Certiva peptides, testing, ordering and shipping.

Read all FAQs
What is the Certiva pen?

A pre-filled, multidose research pen. It arrives factory-sealed, so there is no powder to mix, measure or draw by hand.

Is every batch tested?

Yes. Every batch is independently tested by a third-party laboratory for purity by HPLC, with identity confirmed by mass spectrometry.

Where can I see the certificate for my batch?

On our certificates of analysis page, or by scanning the QR code on your pen. Choose your compound and open the report whose batch number matches the label.

Where are your peptides made?

Manufactured in Britain, with specifications stated on every product listing.

How are orders sent?

Orders are dispatched quickly in temperature-protected packaging and always come with tracking.

Are your peptides for human use?

No. All Certiva peptides are for laboratory in vitro research use only, and are not for human or animal consumption.

How do I get in touch?

Send a message through our contact form and the team will reply within one working day.

        Home/Lab testing

        Certificates of analysis

        Every batch is tested by an independent laboratory before it ships. Find the report that matches the batch number on your pen.

        The batch number is printed on the pen label, for example CRT-2611-047. Scanning the QR code on the pen opens the same report.

        Current batches

        Batches currently shipping

        One row per batch. Open a report to see the chromatogram and every result.

        CompoundBatchPurity (HPLC)IdentityEndotoxinReport dateReport
        The process

        From filled batch to published report

        The same six steps happen for every batch before a single pen is dispatched.

        1. Sample drawn

          Pens are pulled at random from the filled, sealed batch.

        2. Sent to the lab

          Samples travel sealed and chilled to the independent laboratory.

        3. Purity by HPLC

          The main compound’s share of the sample is measured.

        4. Identity by MS

          Molecular mass is checked against the expected sequence.

        5. Endotoxin by LAL

          Measured and reported in EU/mg where documented.

        6. Report published

          The certificate goes live and is linked to the pen’s QR code.

        Test methods

        What each test tells you

        HPLC purity

        High-performance liquid chromatography separates the sample into its components and measures the main compound’s share.

        Reported as
        % of total peak area
        Our specification
        ≥99%

        Mass spectrometry

        Measures molecular mass and compares it with the expected value, confirming the compound is the one on the label.

        Reported as
        Confirmed or not confirmed
        Our specification
        Confirmed, every batch

        Endotoxin (LAL)

        The Limulus amebocyte lysate assay detects bacterial endotoxin. Where a batch hasn’t been tested, the report says so.

        Reported as
        EU/mg
        Typical result
        < 0.5 EU/mg

        Can’t find your batch?

        Send us the batch number from the pen label and your order number. We reply within one working day with the matching report.

          Home/About Certiva

          Made in Britain, tested by someone else

          We synthesise, fill and seal every pen in our own UK facility. Then we hand the proof to an independent laboratory, because a result we checked ourselves is worth less to you.

          Our standards

          Five things we won’t compromise on

          Each one is something you can check on the listing, the label or the certificate.

          UK manufacturing

          Synthesised, purified and filled in our own facility in Britain, never repackaged from bulk bought overseas.

          Where to checkOrigin is stated on every listing

          Independent testing

          Every batch goes to a third-party laboratory for HPLC purity and mass-spectrometry identity before release.

          Where to checkThe batch’s certificate of analysis

          Batch-matched documents

          The batch number on the pen, the box and the certificate are the same. A QR code on the pen opens the report.

          Where to checkScan the pen label

          Cold-chain dispatch

          Insulated packaging with gel packs and tracked next-day delivery, timed so parcels never sit in a depot over a weekend.

          Where to checkYour tracking page

          Research use only

          We supply laboratories and researchers. We don’t give dosing guidance and don’t sell for human or animal use.

          Where to checkOur terms of sale
          Who we supply

          Built for the bench, and only the bench

          Being clear about what we sell is part of the standard.

          • We supplyUniversities, contract research organisations, independent laboratories and qualified researchers.
          • We don’t supplyProducts for human or animal consumption, clinical use or self-administration.
          • We do explainTesting methods, specifications, storage and how to read a certificate.
          • We don’t advise onDosing, protocols in living subjects or any therapeutic use.
          See the certificatesBrowse the shop
          How a pen is made

          Six stages between synthesis and your bench

          1. Synthesis

            Peptides are built residue by residue to the specified sequence.

          2. Purification

            Preparative chromatography removes truncated and side-product sequences.

          3. Formulation

            The purified peptide is brought into a stable liquid formulation.

          4. Fill and seal

            Cartridges are filled, sealed and fitted into the colour-coded pen.

          5. Independent testing

            Sealed samples go to the third-party lab for analysis.

          6. Release

            Only batches that meet specification are released for dispatch.

          Packaging

          What arrives in the box

          Insulated, sealed,
          signed for.
          • Insulated linerKeeps the inside of the box cool for the journey, not for storage.
          • Gel packsConditioned before packing so pens arrive chilled.
          • Protective trayHolds each pen apart so cartridges can’t knock together.
          • Batch documentationA card listing every pen’s batch number, with a QR code to its certificate.
          Returns

          Returns and replacements

          Pens are temperature-sensitive, so the rules are built around keeping your research material reliable.

          If a parcel arrives damaged or warm

          • Tell us within 48 hoursSend your order number and photos of the parcel and pens.
          • Don’t send anything back yetWe’ll confirm what to do with the affected pens.
          • We send a replacementDispatched on the next available day, at no cost.

          Returning unopened pens

          • Within 14 days of deliveryPens must be sealed and stored at 2 °C to 8 °C since arrival.
          • Request a return firstUse the contact form so we can send a cold-pack return label.
          • Refund in 5 working daysIssued to the original payment method once the return arrives.
